material_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Engineered Wood Siding Repaint
material_systems.description: 100% acrylic exterior stain-blocking primer for previously painted engineered wood siding where existing paint has failed or peeled. Spot prime localized failure; full prime on SS_EXT_PEELING. NOT alkali-resistant — engineered wood is neutral pH (key departure from FC RP). Not used on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (skip prime) or SS_EXT_CHALKING (use chalk-binding instead).

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec EXT Primer
products.notes: Standard acrylic stain-block primer — NOT alkali-resistant (EW is neutral pH). Spot prime scraped/feathered areas for localized failure; full prime for SS_EXT_PEELING. LP SmartSide-approved products preferred. spray_backroll or brush_roll application.

prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: spot prime feathered areas and surrounding paint; full prime if widespread
prime_scope_by_state.SS_EXT_PEELING: full surface prime after heavy scrape to sound substrate

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC primer. Same product family as FC RP SYS_EXT_FCRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP. NO alkali-resistant needed — key difference from FC RP.

material_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Engineered Wood Siding
material_systems.description: Low-viscosity chalk-binding conditioner primer that penetrates and binds loose chalk residue on previously painted engineered wood siding. MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING regardless of quality tier. Full surface application required.

products.notes: MANDATORY for chalking EW siding. Penetrates and binds loose chalk particles after power wash. Full surface application required. LP SmartSide-approved products preferred.

material_systems.notes: RP-SPECIFIC primer. Same product family as FC RP SYS_EXT_FCRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND. Higher material consumption due to chalk absorption (~250-350 SF/gal).

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Exposed Factory-Finished EW Substrate (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Bonding primer for exposed LP SmartSide ExpertFinish factory-finished substrate. Required when RP scraping removes field paint and reveals oven-baked factory finish underneath. Secondary/rare primer path.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Insl-X Stix Bonding Primer
products.notes: Rare RP scenario — activated when scraping exposes original ExpertFinish factory finish. Spot prime exposed areas. Same product as NC SYS_EXT_EW_PRIMER_BONDING.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for EW Siding (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Standard 100% acrylic exterior paint for EW siding repaint at QT2/QT3. LP SmartSide-approved products. spray_backroll primary in RP (vs spray-only in NC).

products.notes: LP SmartSide-approved standard acrylic. QT2: single finish coat. QT3: 2 coats. spray_backroll primary (RP). brush_roll fallback.

material_systems.notes: Reuses NC system SYS_EXT_EW_FINISH_STANDARD. Same product — only application method differs.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Finish for EW Siding (Reuse NC)
material_systems.description: Premium 100% acrylic exterior paint for QT4 engineered wood siding repaint. LP SmartSide-approved premium products. Light sand between coats (220-grit). spray_backroll primary.

products.notes: LP SmartSide-approved premium products. Light sand between coats. spray_backroll primary.

coverage_profiles.notes: Previously painted surface absorbs less than bare — higher coverage than NC primer. Textured surfaces absorb more due to paint buildup in texture valleys.
Lower coverage than standard primer — chalk residue aggressively absorbs thin-bodied chalk-binding formula. Full surface application.
Spot prime coverage. Exposed ExpertFinish areas only. Same coverage as NC bonding primer.
Standard coverage on previously painted + primed surface. Same coverage as NC finish — prepped RP surface equivalent to NC primed surface.
Premium coverage. Same rate as standard — premium products have similar coverage, superior performance.

compatibility_rules.description: Chalk-binding primer MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING — no exceptions
Acrylic stain-block primer for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT and SS_EXT_PEELING — NOT alkali-resistant
Bonding primer on exposed ExpertFinish factory-finished substrate only
compatibility_rules.trigger: exposed_substrate = factory_finished AND substrate_state IN (SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_PEELING)

compatibility_rules.description: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT may skip prime with verified adhesion (ROUND_EWRP_2FINISH or ROUND_EWRP_1FINISH)
LP SmartSide requires 100% acrylic exterior latex for finish coats — warranty compliance
QT2 single coat is outside LP SmartSide warranty — note in estimate
NO alkali-resistant primer on engineered wood — neutral pH substrate
NO power washing >1000 PSI — damages OSB core at joints and cut edges
